description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Dark], [Awoken Dark], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Master Assassin Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Dark
description.text: Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Master Assassin Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Master Assassin after using two Dark abilities

description.name: Master Assassin
description.text: 4/6/8 single attacks (0.67 each) if the user has Physical Blink 0/1/2, 100% hit rate
